about.title: About BCA Pools
text: Experienced in pool management since 1984, BCA Pools prides itself on its "hands on" management style, the maturity and excellent training of its lifeguards, and the ability to work with each Association to fit the needs of that community.

BCA Pools prides itself on the backbone of the company - the lifeguards. We know that the guards are the first and last impression you have when you visit your facility. Therefore our courteous staff is always willing to help you in any way possible. With safety the main priority - our guards hold current certifications in lifeguard, first aid, and C.P.R. training. We understand that your success depends on our success, and our success depends on our employees.
Since 1984, BCA Pools has offered reliable pool services in Houston, including management, lifeguards, and maintenance, ensuring your pool operates safely year-round.
